interpretation.name: TightenWithFixedTorqueOverride
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 from the crib to station st2 and tighten the F30 fasteners on line 2 with a fixed target torque instead of the MES tightening program.
constraints: CONFLICT E4: the operator requests a literal target torque (210 N*m), but target torque and tolerance must never appear as literals in a Recipe and are obtained only through get-program.
CONFLICT: no listed service accepts a manually specified torque; configure-tool takes only the result of get-program as the program.
CONFLICT E5: evaluate-tightening needs the result of get-program, so the result cannot be evaluated against its program if get-program is left out.
E1: NR7 must be reserved with reserve-tool before use and released with release-tool afterwards.
E2: transport-tool must be delegated to agvexecutor.
E3: NR7 must be transported to station st2 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners.
E6: every tool-using Step depends on the reserve-tool Step.
E5: every tightening must be evaluated and recorded.
